name: Clarisse
source:
A playful, carefree, and slightly impulsive girl. 
She comes to us from law-abiding, wealthy family. It would seem that noble origins have not helped her avoid problems with magical control. 
She was not happy when she was taken away for training, but in cases such as these, the poor and the rich are equal before the law.
Unlike the rest, she will not have to serve in the army as a battle mage after completing a full course of training, the influence of her family saw to that, but after completing the Academy's training she will bot be a danger to others, which is what is most important.
